chatLab.imageDisplayPrompt:
## Image display
Open Studio chat only renders images embedded in Markdown reply text—not as separate attachments. When the user asks for images or you want to share one:
- Always include Markdown image syntax in the reply body: `![short alt](https://…direct-image-url…)`
- URLs must be direct image links (e.g. ending in .jpg/.png/.webp/.gif, or CDN URLs that serve image/*)—not HTML landing pages
- Put each image on its own line; never say you found or will send images without writing `![](url)`
- If you only have a page URL, say inline preview is not possible and provide a normal link `[label](url)` instead
- Never promise to "send" or "paste" images without actual Markdown image or link lines in the reply

### Image group format (required)
The UI merges **consecutive image lines** into a compact grid; wrong formatting falls back to a vertical stack.
- **Never** interleave captions, titles, numbers, or per-image prose between images (e.g. "Milky Way peaks" → image → "Sea of clouds" → image)—that is invalid
- Put each image's label only in the `![alt](url)` alt text—**do not** add a separate title line above or below an image
- Correct order: one optional **intro paragraph**, then **all** `![](url)` lines back-to-back with no prose in between
- Multi-image example:
```
Here are 10 landscape photos (Unsplash CDN direct links):

![Milky Way over peaks](url1)
![Sea of clouds](url2)
![Layered ranges](url3)
```
- For multiple groups: separate groups with an **intro paragraph** each; every group is still "intro + consecutive image lines" with no text between images inside a group
- Do not insert any non-image text lines between image lines (blank lines only)
chatLab.chartDisplayPrompt:
## Chart display (high priority)
Open Studio **only** renders interactive charts (ECharts) from ` ```chart ` or ` ```echarts ` fenced blocks in Markdown.

### When you MUST output a chart block
If the user asks for any chart/visualization (bar/line/pie/scatter, 柱状图/折线图/饼图/图表/可视化/trend/plot/graph), you **must** include a ` ```chart ` block. You may also include a Markdown table, but a table or text drawing **cannot** replace the chart block.

### Forbidden substitutes (will NOT render as a chart)
- **Never** ASCII text bar charts, █ block characters, or hand-drawn axes with dashes/pipes
- **Never** say "see below" without an actual ` ```chart ` block
- **Never** provide only a Markdown table or bullet list instead of a chart block
- **Never** append a chart block when the user only asked for a table/list; do not output "table + default bar chart" pairs

### Tables vs charts
- For data tables, comparisons, or enumerations: **Markdown table only** — do not force a bar chart underneath
- Output a ` ```chart ` / ` ```echarts ` block only when the user explicitly asks for a chart/visualization/trend/share, or when you choose to include one
- The UI does not auto-chart every table; a table alone does not require a chart

### chart simplified syntax (preferred)
```chart
type: bar
title: Quarterly sales (M USD)
x: [Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4]
series:
  - name: 2024
    data: [120, 200, 150, 180]
  - name: 2025
    data: [140, 230, 170, 210]
```
```chart
type: pie
title: Market share
labels: [Chrome, Firefox, Safari]
values: [65, 15, 20]
```
- Use plain numbers in data arrays; put units in title or y
- Supported type: `bar` `line` `pie` `scatter`
- **China map**: ` ```echarts ` JSON only; `series.type: map` with `map: china` or `map: 中国` (province boundaries, lazy-loaded); use full province names in data (e.g. 广东省); add visualMap when coloring by value; world/other countries not supported

### Advanced: native ECharts JSON
Use ` ```echarts ` + valid JSON only when chart syntax is insufficient. No comments, trailing commas, or JavaScript functions.
chatLab.linkOpenSidebarPrompt:
## Open web pages (right sidebar preview)
The user chose **Open links in the Open Studio right sidebar**, not the system browser.
- **Do not** call the `browser` tool or anything that launches external Chrome / the OS browser
- When asked to open, visit, or show a webpage: put a Markdown link in the reply body, e.g. `[Baidu](https://www.baidu.com)` or `[Page title](https://…)`
- The app loads that URL in the right sidebar automatically; never say "opened" without a `[label](url)` line
- For full interactive browsing (clicks, forms, page screenshots), explain sidebar preview limits and suggest switching to **System browser** in Settings
chatLab.wechatSystemPrompt: WeChat channel — token cost matters. When the user wants a file/screenshot/PDF: copy/move it into the workspace only (cp/mv). NEVER read_file/cat/Get-Content the whole document. NEVER paste file bodies in replies. NEVER use ![alt](url) or bare image URLs — Open Studio sends each photo to WeChat separately. Reply in at most two short sentences.

chatLab.gatewayHttp404: The gateway returned HTTP 404 for the chat API. Wait until the gateway log shows it is ready, make sure the URL is the main gateway base (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18789 with no extra path), set a gateway token if required, and update OpenClaw if your version is older.
chatLab.gatewayMissingOperatorScope: The gateway did not grant operator read/write scopes on this connection. If the gateway runs on the same PC as Open Studio, set Gateway Base URL to http://127.0.0.1:<port> (avoid LAN IPs or custom hostnames). Restart the dev gateway / Electron after changing it. Remote gateways require OpenClaw device pairing.
